rationale:
Issue #720 ("Drop `const` inside library annotations with --fix") reports that the already-existing --fix-optional-const behavior did not apply to directive/library-level metadata. The commit message diagnoses exactly that mechanism: `_constNesting` was tracked in visitMetadata(), which only runs for member-level metadata, while visitAnnotation() is the path all annotations take. The minimized production patch is a single behavioral hunk in lib/src/source_visitor.dart that brackets `visit(node.arguments)` in visitAnnotation() with `_constNesting++/--`, so annotation arguments are treated as const contexts regardless of the annotation's position. This is a correctness gap in existing functionality (inconsistent handling of semantically equivalent constructs), not a new capability. Minimization dropped the CHANGELOG edit and the now-redundant increment/decrement removal in visitMetadata(); leaving that increment in place only double-counts a counter whose semantics are "nesting > 0", so behavior is unchanged, and both strict gates (original and post-minimization) confirm identical results with fixed_all_green and a clean fixed suite. The trigger is the unchanged upstream project-native fixture test/regression/0700/0720.unit driven by test/formatter_test.dart::regression 0720.unit; it uses the pre-existing `(fix optional-const)` harness directive and exercises exactly the reported constructs (`@meta(const Foo(const []))` on `library foo;` and `import 'foo.dart';`), depending on no API introduced by the fix. Strict evidence shows buggy_differential reproduction of that single selector, deterministic fingerprints over 3 repetitions, 32 matrix runs, and buggy full-suite failures limited to the reproduced trigger. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#720 is the sole allowed verified issue key, so no duplicate root cause.

Issue #720 ("Drop `const` inside library annotations with --fix") reports that the already-existing `--fix-optional-const` transformation failed to apply to metadata annotations on library and directive declarations. The commit message states the mechanism precisely: const-context tracking lived in visitMetadata(), which is only reached for member-level metadata, while visitAnnotation() handles all annotations. The minimized production patch is exactly that behavioral correction: four added lines wrapping visit(node.arguments) in visitAnnotation() with _constNesting++/--. It drops the upstream removal of the now-redundant increment in visitMetadata(); since _constNesting is a counter checked for non-zero nesting, retaining it is behavior-preserving and the removal is pure cleanup, so its exclusion is a legitimate minimization rather than a semantic gap. No new production API, flag, or option is introduced. The trigger is the unchanged upstream project-native fixture test/regression/0700/0720.unit, which exercises the pre-existing `(fix optional-const)` harness directive on `@meta(const Foo(const []))` above `library foo;` and `import 'foo.dart';` - the exact scenario in the issue - through the existing test/formatter_test.dart regression runner, so it depends only on APIs present in the buggy revision. Strict evidence for both the original and post-minimization matrices passes every gate with no failed checks: build on both revisions, unique selector, buggy differential reproducing test/formatter_test.dart::regression 0720.unit in isolation and in-suite, fixed clean across isolated/suite/reversed runs, deterministic fingerprints over 3 repetitions, and fixed full suite green with buggy full-suite failures limited to the declared trigger. active_same_project_root_causes is empty and dart-lang/dart_style#720 is the supplied allowed key, so no duplicate root cause exists. Excluded CHANGELOG.md is documentation-only and correctly absent from the minimized patch.
